path.description: Sends the leaf `shopping_domain_search` answered, or the kind above its leaves. A shelf, domain or top answers `not_a_leaf` naming leaves; an area sil does not carry yet `not_carried`.

query.description: Sends what the buyer wants, in English — "quiet, small counter, about €100" — so the specs it reaches come first.

spec_keywords.description: Sends the specs the agent is looking for, in a word each; the specs they name rank first.

page.description: Reads on: the `next_page` the last answer gave.
